LEO Innovation Lab as an operating model		LEO Pharma could see digital disruption coming to healthcare. Its answer was an arm's-length innovation lab: better to disrupt ourselves than let a competitor do it. The lab was incredibly agile, with rapid learning cycles and brilliant peers, but too remote: the innovations struggled to find a home in the core business.The lab worked in isolation; the parent ship sailed on unchanged, and the model was not sustainable.
